content:
claire: Quick flag  linkcheck failing on headings that include HTML entities and pipe chars. Example heading `# Rate limits — overview | per-tenant` produced two different fragments in mkdocs vs docusaurus. Old links to `#rate-limits-overview` now 404.

matt: Reproduced. Docusaurus slugify keeps `—` as literal `mdash` while mkdocs converts to an en dash. The pipe `|` is stripped differently too. Linkcheck shows 6 failures referencing that page.

hana: I opened PR 4699 to NFC-normalize entities and to replace `|` with `-` during slugify. Minimal change but it touches the slug pipeline so we need tests.

docbot: linkcheck: docs/security/rate-limits.md 6 broken links (branch/4699). Full report: https://ci.redwood-inference.local/links/4699

claire: Can we avoid rewriting content? Prefer a build-time normalization that maps variant slugs -> canonical slug and emits a small redirects map so external links don't break.

matt: Plan: implement a slug-normalizer plugin that (1) resolves HTML entities to unicode, (2) collapses punctuation to single hyphens, and (3) preserves punctuation inside inline code spans. We'll also add `scripts/collect_variant_slugs.py --emit` to produce a redirects snippet from git history.

hana: I like that. Add a feature flag `enable_slug_normalization` in the docusaurus plugin config so we can stage it. Also include unit tests for headings with `|`, `—`, emojis, and backticks.

ci-bot: build: branch/4699  linkcheck shows 2 remaining failures in third-party imported guides. Suggest running the collect script to catch their legacy slugs.

claire: I'll run the collector against main and paste the top variants here. If fewer than 30 entries, we'll emit redirects.json; otherwise we'll prioritize fixing source files.

matt: Note: normalizing `|` -> `-` can change meaning in a couple terse titles. We'll ensure the canonical slug is readable (e.g., `rate-limits-overview-per-tenant`) and add an advisory in changelog.

hana: Also added a fallback: if both variants exist on a page, plugin will emit HTML meta <link rel="canonical"> to discourage external indexing of the old form.

docbot: preview: https://deploy-preview-4699.docs.redwood-inference.com/ (staging)

claire: After staging linkcheck passes, coordinate with support to monitor 404s for a week. I'll draft a short release note about anchor normalization and the redirects file location.

matt: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4699 (WIP). Please add test cases if you see other edge chars.

hana: Quick tip: test on macOS and Linux; filesystem normalization can mask unicode entity differences locally.

claire: Thanks team. We'll merge after staging checks and a devex review for any visible title changes.
